beats.text: Apple’s most famous advert was shown nationally only once.
beats.note: It aired during Super Bowl XVIII on CBS on 22 January 1984.

beats.name: Ridley Scott
beats.role: Director of the one minute advert, made with the agency Chiat/Day.

beats.text: It had already run once in Idaho.
beats.note: Wikipedia lists KMVT in Twin Falls as the first broadcast, on 31 December 1983.
Wikipedia says the entire board disliked the commercial.
The New York Times reported $370,000, a 2005 account said $900,000, and Scott said under $250,000.

beats.text: You’ll see why 1984 won’t be like ‘1984’.

beats.line: One airing can outlast a campaign.
